divergences.upstreamResult: The pinned React adapter publishes with @tanstack/devtools 0.12.4.
divergences.rationale: The workspace catalog had advanced before this audit; silently downgrading the shared core is outside this harness PR.
divergences.consumerImpact: Core behavior may include patch-level changes beyond the pinned React adapter.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Review 0.12.4 to 0.12.5 core changes when exact-version parity is required.
divergences.reviewCondition: Remove when both adapters resolve the same core version.

divergences.upstreamResult: Adapter types are named TanStackDevtoolsReactPlugin and TanStackDevtoolsReactInit.
divergences.octaneResult: Adapter types are named TanStackDevtoolsOctanePlugin and TanStackDevtoolsOctaneInit.
divergences.rationale: Framework-specific public type names identify the runtime they describe.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if framework-neutral aliases are introduced.

divergences.upstreamResult: The React adapter exports only the component and React adapter types.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane additionally re-exports framework-neutral core values and types.
divergences.rationale: Existing Octane consumers use the binding as the plugin-authoring type boundary.
divergences.consumerImpact: Octane has an additive public surface.
divergences.migrationGuidance: React-targeted code should import these symbols from @tanstack/devtools directly.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if the additive exports are removed or upstream adds them.
